nameEn: Retail sale of furniture, lighting equipment and other household articles in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of furniture, lighting equipment and household articles in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of furniture: chairs, tables, wardrobes, beds
retail sale of lighting equipment: lamps, chandeliers, wall lights
retail sale of household articles: china, glassware, kitchenware, cutlery
retail sale of kitchen equipment: pots, pans, baking trays
retail sale of wooden articles, wickerwork and cork products
retail sale of non-electric household appliances: irons, toasters, kettles (non-electronic)
excludes: retail sale of electrical household appliances, see 4741
